_comment: Every headline count in this project, as DOCUMENTED in the research
materials, next to what was actually REPRODUCED on 2026-09-13 during
repository organization (Python 3.14.7, macOS arm64, single core).
'reproduced' null means the run was not performed here.
Raw stdout for each run is in results/logs/.

order_type_enumeration.note: Counts agree with Aichholzer-Aurenhammer-Krasser. Only NECESSARY sign conditions are imposed, so this is a superset of the realizable order types.

classification.note: The script reports the class count (14), not the labelled count (16); the 16 figure was not separately re-derived here.

E7.note: I=42 dies at AKR Lemma 7, independently confirming the hand proof.

E9.note: 2300 and 121 are REPRESENTATIVE-LABELLING DEPENDENT (defect D2). The older superseded pipeline reported 3522 and 64 for the same stages. Only the final 0 is labelling-invariant; see the per-pair run below.

sum_check.note: Confirms defect D1: the original enum9.py total of 13,484,940 was the union over |E| in {7,8,9}, not the 9-edge count.

per_ordered_class_pair.note: This is the labelling-invariant form of the final elimination, and the correction for defect D2.

NOT_reproduced_here: COMPLETENESS of the 225-case list: the certificate and its checker establish that each listed case dies, not that the list is exhaustive. Completeness rests on the 13,003,620-graph enumeration inside the generator, which no independent implementation has repeated. See docs/known-issues.md K-02 and K-03.

The 13,484,940 / 43,330 / 3,522 / 64 figures of the superseded pipeline -- archive/superseded/python/enum9.py cannot run without the missing ot7.pkl, and its downstream stages (combine.py, final.py) are absent entirely.

Implementation B: SUPERSEDED NOTE (2026-09-14) -- this said no source code existed. It does: independent/implementation_b/ reproduces the reduction to the 225-triple set. It does NOT run the final avoiding-pair filter (K-20). See docs/known-issues.md K-02, K-20.

The validation suite's realizable-configuration checks (3,952 random pairs; 129,812 high-intersection configurations) -- python/validation/validate.py section 1 needs the missing best_7_7_*.pkl; see docs/known-issues.md K-05.
Both SHA-256 digests quoted in docs/proof-outline.md -- the original serialization format is unrecorded; see docs/known-issues.md K-07.

final_elimination_certificate.note: Every claim of proof-outline.md Step 8 reproduced exactly, including its worked example (case 0: class 12, N=[{0},{0},{1},{2,4},{3},{4},{5,6}], avoiding pair (4,6), M_P={0,2,3,4,6}). The independent checker verified all 225 contradictions and was validated against ten adversarial controls. The certificate proves each listed case dies; it does NOT prove the list is complete. See docs/known-issues.md K-03.

cerny_lemma_3_redundancy.note: The 15,288 graphs Cerny L3 removes are all removed by crossing-set compatibility anyway, so L3 is redundant GIVEN that filter. The elimination rests on four published lemmas, not five. See docs/known-issues.md K-06.
